rationale: Collaboration workspace owns namespace and membership; Jupyter UI workspace owns layout; runtime session owns processes. None owns the governed analytical work definition and lifecycle.

The prior CBV interaction reducer is candidate/unadjudicated and lacks exact selection identity, resolution, clear/reset, null, stale-field and serialization laws. Generic UI gesture mapping remains an adapter outside selection semantics.
Language/type semantics, reversible state transitions and population aggregation have different laws, dependencies, cost and replacement cadence.
